# Mike & Laura Travel

> > A travel blog and online business resource combining destination guides for French Polynesia and Steamboat Springs with courses on blog monetization, SEO, and audience-building strategies.

Mike & Laura Travel serves travel enthusiasts and aspiring travel bloggers with practical guides to popular destinations and comprehensive training on scaling a travel blog through email marketing, social media strategy, and content systems. The site leverages platforms like Facebook, Kit, and ThriveCart to help creators build profitable online businesses.

## Travel Destination Guides

- [Travel To French Polynesia - Mike & Laura Travel](https://mikeandlauratravel.com/french-polynesia-travel-guides): Comprehensive French Polynesia travel guide covering Tahiti, Moorea, and Bora Bora with destination insights and recommendations
- [Travel To Steamboat Springs - Mike & Laura Travel](https://mikeandlauratravel.com/steamboat-springs): Steamboat Springs, Colorado travel guide with local recommendations and activities for visitors

## Blog Monetization & Strategy Courses

- [The Facebook Traffic Goldmine: Turn Posts into Profit » Powered by ThriveCart](https://mikeandlauratravel.com/scale): Scale Your Blog 2.0 course using Email-First Blog Framework and Facebook traffic strategy to monetize travel content
- [Travel Blogging + SEO Resources - Mike & Laura Travel](https://mikeandlauratravel.com/travel-blogging-seo-resources): Travel blogging and SEO resources including courses on scaling and launching profitable travel blogs
